in_marathi.name: Shibam
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of Prosperity
in_marathi.long_meaning: Shibam हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Shibam is derived from the Sanskrit word Shiva, which means 'God of Prosperity'. It is also associated with the concept of Shakti, the divine feminine power. In Hindu mythology, Shiva is considered to be the supreme god, the destroyer of evil, and the giver of boons.
